notes.title: King of Meat Release Date
notes.notes:
Unleash your ridiculous when King of Meat releases on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam on October 7, 2025. Aspiring Contenders can pre-order King of Meat: Standard Edition or King of Meat: Deluxe Edition for bonus cosmetics like the Venerable Defender Legendary Costume, plus 5 days of early access.
[p align="start"]King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against unpredictable traps, quirky puzzles, and wacky monsters. Become a fearless Contender as you battle through and build devious dungeons for gory, gory, glory.
[p align="start"]
Deluxe Edition Bonus[p align="start"]Heroes get remembered, but legends never die, especially in Ironlaw Plaza where you can buy all of your favourite Contender merchandise. Develop your own style, starting with the Tapeboard Betsy and Emerson Shard Character Sets—exclusive to the Deluxe Edition—to stand out on the shelves and up at Komstruct Koliseum.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/0bbb5d5b10def5cd82f1cf5b3a5c8788f32956e3.jpg"]Whether you prefer to conquer nightmarish obstacles or create the dungeon of your dreams, King of Meat celebrates player interaction. Read on to learn about ways to connect with the King of Meat community outside of Loregok, plus how to get involved if you’re interested in our Creator program. If you’re passionate about dungeon creation, we also have opportunities for you to join the Komstructor Collective.

Technical Test

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/7351dccc450661f3b8c70982735d8d5d7dc9a5da.jpg"]

Can’t wait to play? Join the King of Meat Technical Test. This Technical Test will run from August 23, 10 a.m. PT until August 24, 10 a.m. PT on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The most-watched, sometimes controversial, but always talked-about survival gameshow awaits. Help influence the future of King of Meat, earn special rewards, and get famous or die trying alongside your friends.
[p align="start"]Check out our Technical Test Details blog for additional information.

Come Die With Me[p align="start"]Four fiendishly ingenious Creators, one spectacular trophy, and seemingly infinite Create Mode ingredients clash in Come Die With Me. Watch the Sidemen compete for the highest score as they serve each other nightmarish dungeons, or clever artistic expressions depending on who you ask. What could possibly go wrong?
[p align="start"]Catch the full video and then look forward to playing these levels with your frenemies.


Annals of Agony[p align="start"]Join six-time champion and nine-time intensive care patient, Juliana Spiderhead, as she untangles the Annals of Agony, a tantalizing glimpse into the rich history of the greatest game show in the universe—King of Meat. Throughout this video series, Juliana will provide a never before seen look at the show’s only banned weapon, take us closer than ever to the man inside the Buzzworth Billy costume, and more. Tune into the first episode here and then view the Annals of Agony tapestry for even greater untold King of Meat legends.


Community Platforms[p align="start"]The King of Meat Discord is the best place to reach our team. Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make King of Meat better for every type of player. You can also look forward to community events, activities, and more after launch.
[p align="start"]Interested in the latest updates? Follow our social accounts and visit this site for exclusive content, community highlights, and the latest information on all things King of Meat.


Komstructor Collective[p align="start"]All of the dungeons in King of Meat have been made with the same tools that you will use to create your own fiendish playgrounds. If you can play it, you can build it. There will be around 100 levels available for you to play at launch, but that number will quickly grow as the community pushes Create Mode beyond its limits.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/c2cd3635adf29bba3f2b987a4488505f86c070e4.jpg"]

The Komstructor Collective is a group of exemplary community members that love making dungeons. If you’d like to join, please submit your dungeons in Discord throughout our Technical Test. If your creations catch our eye, we’ll reach out via Discord. We’ll also host "Build Challenges" for you to show off your creativity and potentially join the Komstructor Collective. There’s no restrictions or requirements for what you can build, we just want to help empower players that love Create Mode.
[p align="start"]Komstructor Collector perks include:

Featured in-game dungeons and title

Exclusive Discord channels

Appearance in the game credits for those that join pre-launch

Exclusive in-game Contender skin

Feedback play sessions

And more!
Creator Programme[p align="start"]Collaborate with the King of Meat team and other creative members of the community through our Creator Programme. Whether you’re a streamer, YouTuber, wiki author, cosplayer, artist, musician, or anyone else who makes something to contribute to the love of King of Meat, we want to find ways to support you.


[p align="start"]There are no requirements to apply other than a desire to create great King of Meat content. Learn more and sign up on our Creator Programme page.
[p align="start"]We can’t wait to welcome you into the world of Loregok on 7 October. Explore our values overview article for more information on what to expect from King of Meat and then stay tuned to this site, along with our social channels for future updates.
